usage.outputShape: body is a base64-encoded JPEG image with a literal 'base64:' prefix (e.g. 'base64:/9j/4AAQ...'); Content-Type: image/jpeg
quirks: Input is a GET request with ?url= query param — there is no JSON body and no inputSchema in the registry; the url parameter is required but undocumented
Response body has a literal 'base64:' prefix before the base64 JPEG data — callers must strip 'base64:' before decoding
A second /animate endpoint exists at the same price for animated (GIF) captures
usage.guide: Make a GET request to https://screenshotone.x402.paysponge.com/take with the target page URL as the ?url= query parameter. The x402 payment of $0.02 USDC on Base is handled automatically. The response body is a base64-encoded JPEG prefixed with 'base64:' — strip that prefix before decoding. For animated captures use the /animate endpoint at the same price. No API key is required.
